BiblicalUsage: Jahzeel stands among Naphtali's four sons who went down into Egypt. Forty years later the wilderness census still counts his family, the Jahzeelites, among Naphtali's households.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jahzeel's name travelled the same road as his brothers': down into Egypt as a son, and out into the wilderness as a family, and the census keeps the son and the family tied together.
